querystring.select: SELECT RMADD.DESCR AS AddressTypeName, CAH.ADDR AS Address, RMBUI.DESCR AS BuildingOwnership, CONCAT(CAH.PHN_AREA_1, '-', CAH.PHN_1 ) AS Phone1, CONCAT(CAH.PHN_AREA_2, '-', CAH.PHN_2 ) AS Phone2, CAH.NOTES AS Notes FROM CUST_ADDR_HIST CAH JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER RMADD  ON RMADD.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = 'ADDR_TYPE' AND RMADD.MASTER_CODE = CAH.MR_CUST_ADDR_TYPE_CODE JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER RMBUI ON RMBUI.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = 'BUILDING_OWNERSHIP' AND RMBUI.MASTER_CODE = CAH.MR_BUILDING_OWNERSHIP_CODE WHERE CAH.CUST_ID = 16
querystring.from: FROM CUST_ADDR_HIST CAH JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER RMADD  ON RMADD.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = 'ADDR_TYPE' AND RMADD.MASTER_CODE = CAH.MR_CUST_ADDR_TYPE_CODE JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER RMBUI ON RMBUI.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = 'BUILDING_OWNERSHIP' AND RMBUI.MASTER_CODE = CAH.MR_BUILDING_OWNERSHIP_CODE
